estsauthpersistent.useForSilentRenewal: /oauth2/v2.0/authorize?prompt=none uses ESTSAUTHPERSISTENT for SSO, mints fresh code without TOTP
estsauthpersistent.description: Microsoft KMSI cookie issued at LoginOptions=1 via Resolve-EntraInterruptPage

unattendedAuth.sccauthNote: sccauth cookie itself is ~1h life. Renew via silent /authorize+prompt=none using ESTSAUTHPERSISTENT (not via fresh TOTP every cycle).

reauthCadence.comparedToV1: v1 does full TOTP-MFA every 50 min (sccauth ~1h life). v2 keeps ESTSAUTHPERSISTENT 90d, silent renewal between bootstraps.
reauthCadence.steadyState: Refresh access_token every ~50 min via refresh_token (NO TOTP)
reauthCadence.bootstrap: Once per portal per ~85 days (TOTP or Passkey)

refreshToken.originHeader: Required for SPA client_id types per AADSTS9002327
refreshToken.description: Issued when scope contains offline_access; renews access_token silently

conditionalAccess.requireCompliantDevice: Both FAIL; operator must exclude SA from this policy
conditionalAccess.requireHybridJoin: Both FAIL; operator must exclude SA from this policy

unattendedStatus: audience known; tenantId query param required per nodoc

kvSecretSchema.description: Per-portal KV secrets following v1's mde-portal-* pattern
